_comment: MS1.1 required-component inventory (plan rev 6, macOS plan:396-401; RoseCat 5968/5974).
The universal macOS app bundles native Mach-O code beyond the browser. The census
(tests/e2e/mac_universal_test.py) scans the WHOLE bundle for every Mach-O and requires
each fat (x86_64 + arm64) — so an unlisted single-arch binary cannot sneak through — AND
requires every role below present AT ITS EXACT path pattern, so a stray python3/claude/
zb-claude in the wrong location cannot satisfy a role. 'path_glob' is an fnmatch pattern
on the bundle-root-relative path. Probing fails closed: a file `file` cannot classify
rejects the census. Non-executable 'resources' must be present, and their byte-equality
across the two per-arch trees is enforced before lipo by the resource_compat oracle
routes both arch trees through; a single-arch tree here cannot do that comparison.
